_comment: The diners the racers go to, by level (see docs/modding.md, "diners"). Each takes the cars from powerFrom
horsepower up to the next diner's floor: a racer is a regular of the diner their car's dyno figure puts them in (a
boss of the top one), and the regulars of a diner above the player's car won't race them, though every diner is open
to go and look. The first diner (from 0) is where everybody starts out. street: the street the diner stands on (a
street with a diner.json); one with no such street yet is seen on the first diner's street. stakes: how many times
the house limits the cash bets go for there. name, about: text keys (left out: diner.name.<id>, diner.about.<id>).
